title: Using Tab key to switch control focus inside a SubViewportContainer switches focus outside the SubViewport
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.8.dev.custom_build [4e244f211]
- Reproducible in v4.7.2.stable
- Reproducible in v4.6.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (4e244f211) - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 04 Sep 2026 15:41:39 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080 @ 74.97 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 74.97 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 30.48 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When you press <kbd>Tab</kbd> while a control inside a SubViewportContainer has focus, focus leaves the SubViewportContainer entirely to focus on the "next" control. This makes GUIs embedded inside a SubViewportContainer impractical to use with keyboard-only input, or when trying to use <kbd>Tab</kbd> to quickly switch between fields.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07655b9f-c6ac-416b-bc1d-7a71dfd4daba

### Steps to reproduce

- Download the MRP, or create a scene with of GridContainer and a few SpinBoxes, then duplicate the container inside a SubViewportContainer.
- Launch the project, focus a SpinBox on the top level, press <kbd>Tab</kbd> to cycle between controls.
- Do the same inside the SubViewportContainer, focus immediately switches to the top level controls.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ui-focus.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32548806/ui-focus.zip)
